newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian alliance expects call to form government.
newsitem.headline: Indian alliance expects call to form government.

text.p: India's United Front said on Sunday that it expected President Shankar Dayal Sharma to invite its leader, Inder Kumar Gujral, to form a new centre-left government.
"We expect the president will soon extend a formal invitation to Inder Kumar Gujral to form the government," Jaipal Reddy, spokesman for the 15-party alliance, told reporters in the capital.

Earlier on Sunday, Sharma had told the United Front and its uneasy ally, the Congress party, to prove the proposed new centre-left government would be more stable than its predecessor which fell after 10 months in power.

Sharma's demand had slowed the formation of a new government and raised the prospect that Congress and the United Front would be unable to provide the assurances the president was demanding, triggering a political crisis.

Reddy said the United Front and Congress had agreed to establish a committee to improve coordination between the two formations, which during the reign of caretaker Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda kept each other at arm's length.

The two formations met Sharma later on Sunday to inform him of the coordination mechanism. "We expect the president will soon extend a formal invitation to Inder Kumar Gujral to form the government," Reddy said.
